exposure: placental transverse relaxation time (T2*) estimated by MRI
outcome: small for gestational age (SGA) at birth
cohort: A mixed cohort of 85 pregnancies from a study hospital's placental MRI database, with MRI performed between gestational weeks 15-41.
finding: Among the MRI parameters investigated, placental T2* was identified as the only independent predictor of SGA in a multi-variate model.
birth_weight: Includes babies identified as small for gestational age (SGA) and normal birthweight (BW > -22% of expected for GA).
gest_age: MRI performed at gestational weeks 15-41; outcomes assessed at birth.
